content: Implement retry decisions for an internal HTTP client. Retry only status 429, 500, 502, 503 and 504. Our product policy allows only GET, HEAD and PUT; method names should be case-insensitive.
The first draft checks the common retryable server statuses. I suggested allowing every method on a server error.

Reject retries for every method. POST can duplicate side effects. DELETE is also excluded by our product policy, even if a generic HTTP reference treats it as idempotent. The allowlist is exactly GET, HEAD and PUT.
The current checkpoint still has only the status check; I have not added the method gate or 429 yet.
Checkpoint probe: should_retry(503,"POST") -> True (known incorrect); should_retry(429,"GET") -> False (pending change).
Use integer status codes and string methods; no networking or delay logic belongs in this helper.
The function is pure. The public smoke can check a rate-limit response and a missing resource.
Finish the pending retry policy change in retry.py. Add the rate-limit status and run the public smoke checks.
I will finish should_retry without implementing an HTTP client.
